sources.title: Redis EXPIRE command reference
sources.corpus_version_note: Live command reference; assess Redis Open Source 7.2; later additions require applicability check
sources.relevant_applicability: The page dates GT to 7.0.0, so it is available in 7.2. Its live text states HSET preserves an existing key timeout, SET replacement clears it by default, persistent keys are infinite for GT, and skipped conditions return 0.

sources.title: Redis keyspace notifications
sources.corpus_version_note: Live Redis documentation; the retrieved page is not an archived 7.2 snapshot. Used for general key-expiry notification behavior; exact runtime should be confirmed in acceptance testing.
sources.relevant_applicability: The page states notifications default off, non-positive expiry produces del, expired events occur on deletion and may lag TTL zero, and Pub/Sub is fire-and-forget.
